column1: # browser-script.tsv (harbor#1507): the fixed scripts `harbor chrome` runs in a page for its script-first verbs.
# WHY: macOS reports a page `hidden` when its window is covered, and Playwright's click waits for paint, so a click
# on a covered agent window timed out (64 in 3 days, 2026-11-10..12). These dispatch the events on the element and
# need no paint: live 2026-11-12 on a hidden window they opened a dialog and a menu, switched a tab, followed a link.
# Both routes read this file (bin/access-chrome-mcp.ts, bin/access-browser-agent.sh), so they cannot drift.
# The code is fixed: the agent supplies only a snapshot ref, and __ARG__ is replaced with a JSON literal (a check's
# true or false, a select's list of values, a scroll's pixels or null). Free-form eval stays refused.
# Each returns two lines: what it did (or `refused: ` / `unchanged: `), then `- Page URL: <url>`.
# `timing` is the one row that is not script-first: a fixed, read-only probe with no ref and no __ARG__, run by the
# `timing` verb. WHY: a timing parity check between a prod dashboard and its rebuild needs the page's own clock, which no
# snapshot or screenshot carries. It returns one JSON object: navigation (responseStart, domContentLoadedEventEnd,
# loadEventEnd), lcp (the latest largest-contentful-paint startTime, buffered; null when the page has none), now, and
# resources, the page's own-origin entries as {path, initiatorType, startTime, responseEnd, duration, transferSize} with
# the query and fragment cut from path. Every number is rounded to a whole ms (transferSize: bytes).
# `submit-focus` and `submit-of` (harbor#1541) are read-only probes, not verbs: what Enter or Space would commit. For the
# focused element (press, keydown, type --submit) or a ref (fill --submit) they return the label of the control itself
# when it is a button, link or menu item, plus the label of every submit button of its form, as one line. The server
# matches that against contracts/live-change-words.txt before the key is sent. A page whose Enter handler is script on
# a field outside any form returns nothing here: that residual is recorded in the contract, not hidden.
# `shown-secret` (contracts/secret-intake.md) is a read-only probe, not a verb: what a screenshot or pdf would paint, as
# text — the body's innerText plus the value of every input and textarea but a password field (it paints as dots). Both
# routes pipe it to `bin/access-redact.sh --check` and refuse the image when a credential shows: an image cannot be redacted.
# `intake-read` (contracts/secret-intake.md, 2026-11-23) is the `intake` verb's read, run by the shell agent through the
# pinned CLI's `run-code` (a page function: eval runs in the page and cannot grant a permission), never free-form: __ARG__
# is the snapshot ref as a JSON string. It grants the page's origin clipboard-read, reads THIS Chrome's own clipboard
# (headless, it is never the macOS one) and the value of the input or textarea at the ref, and returns one JSON object
# {intake: 1, clip, field, err?} that is piped into `harbor access … --value-stdin`, never printed; err is the read's error
# name only (NotAllowedError), so a failed read is told from an empty clipboard. `intake-clear` runs before the click: it
# empties THIS Chrome's clipboard and answers {intake: 1, cleared}, so a Copy that copies nothing reads as empty, never
# as the last intake's key.

Math.round(n) : null); const nav = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0]; const lcp = await new Promise((done) => { let last = null; const keep = (l) => { if (l.length) last = l[l.length - 1]; }; try { const o = new PerformanceObserver((list) => keep(list.getEntries())); o.observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true }); keep(o.takeRecords()); setTimeout(() => { keep(o.takeRecords()); o.disconnect(); done(last); }, 100); } catch (e) { done(null); } }); const resources = []; for (const e of performance.getEntriesByType('resource')) { let u; try { u = new URL(e.name, location.href); } catch (x) { continue; } if (u.origin !== location.origin) continue; resources.push({ path: u.pathname, initiatorType: e.initiatorType, startTime: ms(e.startTime), responseEnd: ms(e.responseEnd), duration: ms(e.duration), transferSize: ms(e.transferSize) }); } return { navigation: nav ? { responseStart: ms(nav.responseStart), domContentLoadedEventEnd: ms(nav.domContentLoadedEventEnd), loadEventEnd: ms(nav.loadEventEnd) } : null, lcp: lcp ? ms(lcp.startTime) : null, now: ms(performance.now()), resources }; }
